W!=0 likewise prevents the local first-world producer, but this prefix still ORs the bit, overwrites its source record and increments the odd-phase tally. Repeating the generic call is not proved behaviorally idempotent. This case supplies no authorization to reissue claimed bonuses.

Accepted bonus stores such as Irrigation population still require phase lowbit1, while presentation can follow separate bit1 gates. Shared F is overwritten by nested acquisitions and is not restored around them; later callback/caller cadence and state lifetime prevent a once-only reward theorem.

conclusion: Apollo active-Wonder state supplies a virtual technology-ownership shortcut for supported1..46. A direct admitted generic acquisition can still write a missing raw bit and produce the native first-world flag; this differs from the ordinary science caller, which requires virtual ownership false first. Raw-unowned filtering, source/phase policy, flag lifetime and actual bonus delivery remain necessary before any optional Apollo reward behavior. Repeated raw-owned calls can alter the acquisition tally and are not idempotent. completionFinalizationBoundary binds conditional D16330/D16344 state and local repeat barriers, plus one supported Irrigation composition with collateral ownership/discoverer/source/tally effects; this is not an isolated bonus API or safe mass-grant/replay contract.
